create_webhook_adapter: create a WebhookAdapter instance to receive and process HTTP webhook POSTs from external services
validate_webhook_signature: validate HMAC-SHA256 signatures on incoming webhook requests from GitHub, GitLab, or generic providers
render_webhook_prompt: render a prompt template string by resolving dot-notation placeholders against a webhook JSON payload
deliver_github_comment: post the agent response as a GitHub PR or issue comment via the gh CLI
deliver_cross_platform: route an agent response to another connected platform such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, or Signal
